author: reek
body: Theme-building helpers shared by every browser app. These are the short constructors every Page chapter used to define locally: border sides, edges, widget styles, and flat state-style sets. An app keeps only its palette and CSS text; everything mechanical lives here.

author: reek
body: inject-app-style installs the app's Theme and its CSS text into the document head. This is the init plumbing every app repeated verbatim; the palette and the CSS string are the only per-app inputs.
